summary: Climber stranded on the Diamond, Longs Peak, after missing a rappel anchor; extracted uninjured by rangers and helicopter.
responding_agency: Rocky Mountain National Park rangers, helicopter
notes: MERGED run 353: NPS morning-report account corroborates (C.D., 27, Fort Collins; stuck off the fixed rappel route on The Diamond July 20; ranger reach 12:15 a.m.; flown out 8 a.m.). Reviewed October 1, 2026: Estes Park News (published July 22, 2010) corroborates the July 20 rescue. Rangers assisted the climber to Table Ledge and the summit via upper Kiener’s Route; roughly 25 people participated, including five RMRG members on standby. Submission e1359b5a-3aaa-4241-a6d4-db0df6392ca9 incorrectly dated this as 2021 and is merged here. The reports do not explicitly establish the county; the existing county classification is retained.
